campaigns.title: Launch Trailer Clipping Blitz
campaigns.brief: Cut our new trailer into short highlight clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Focus on the biggest reveal moments and any big reactions.
campaigns.requirements: Vertical format, 15-60s, include our logo watermark, caption the key line of dialogue.

campaigns.title: Podcast Highlight Clips
campaigns.brief: Turn our long-form podcast episodes into punchy highlight clips people will want to share.
campaigns.requirements: Add captions, keep under 90s, credit the podcast handle in the caption.
